description: The overlay listens for panel state pushed from Rust, and asks the shell to start a window drag from its header while the panel is draggable (inside or detached), and a sideways resize from the expanded panel's bottom corners. The setup window listens for setup state and can close itself. The overlay also takes clicks on its buttons and the search view's typing. The Grind Tracker's window listens for its figures, asks for a window drag from its header, and takes clicks on its buttons. The Personal Bests window listens for its rows, asks for a window drag from its header, and takes clicks on its close button. The Item Lookup alert listens for what the latest lookup came to, and takes a click on an item to pick. The Item Card listens for the card to show, and takes clicks on its close button, its links and an item to pick.
